class.name: AudioBusListSettings
class.brief_description: Settings resource of [AudioBusSettingsServer]: the stored values of all audio buses.
class.description: The data of the settings domain [code]"audio_buses"[/code]: one [AudioBusSettings] per bus. It holds nothing but the list, so [AudioBusSettingsServer] can store it as CSV with one row per bus. [AudioBusSettingsServer] keeps three copies of it (defaults, applied and pending values, see [method SettingsServer.get_settings]); use the methods of [AudioBusSettingsServer] and [ListSettingsServer] to change the entries.

members.member: The entries, one per bus, identified by [member AudioBusSettings.bus_name].
